jobs.title: DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.description:
DevSecOps Engineer

The Senior DevSecOps Engineer is a hands-on Senior DevOps Engineer with focused responsibility for integrating security into cloud infrastructure, delivery pipelines, developer workflows, and production platform practices across F&P Solutions. The role combines broad AWS, Kubernetes/EKS, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, automation, and troubleshooting capability with deep expertise in IAM governance, vulnerability and open-source scanning, static analysis, policy as code, software supply chain security, cloud and container security, and automated compliance evidence. The job holder enables product teams to deliver securely by translating enterprise requirements into practical, reusable controls rather than relying on manual reviews or end-stage security gates. The role works closely with Product, Development, Architecture, Security, BISO, Quality, SRE, cloud service owners, and compliance stakeholders, bringing strong communication, sound judgment, and end-to-end ownership.

What You’ll Bring

• Five or more years of experience in DevOps, cloud, platform, infrastructure, security, or software engineering environments.
• Experience working in an enterprise or global organization with distributed teams.
• Experience collaborating with security, compliance, enterprise architecture, cloud platform, SRE, vendor, and product teams.
• Experience with Datadog, CloudWatch, SonarQube/SonarQ, JFrog, Veracode, LaunchDarkly, Helm, Ansible, secrets management, or similar platforms.
• Familiarity with application stacks such as PostgreSQL, .NET, Angular, APIs, or cloud-native microservices.
• Relevant AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, DevOps, platform engineering, or security certifications.
• Experience mentoring engineers, raising technical standards, and enabling adoption through documentation, coaching, reusable examples, and hands-on collaboration.
• Experience supporting ISO 27001, audit readiness, secure software development lifecycle practices, or regulated environments.
• Experience with Veracode, SonarQube/SonarQ, JFrog, GitLab security capabilities, AWS security services, Open Policy Agent, Gatekeeper, or equivalent tools.
• Familiarity with threat modeling, security architecture reviews, SBOM, artifact signing, provenance, or supply chain security frameworks.
• Relevant cloud security, DevSecOps, application security, Kubernetes security, or information security certifications.

jobs.title: AI-Native Platform Engineer - DevOps, Security & Compliance | Zenara Health (India)
jobs.description:
Description

AI-Native Platform Engineer — DevOps, Security & Compliance, Mid to Senior | Zenara Health

Location: Remote - India

Type: Full-time

Working Hours: All meetings and live collaboration happen between approximately 6:00 PM and 12:00 AM IST, overlapping US Pacific Time. Attendance in that window is required. Your remaining work is yours to schedule.

Commitment: Approximately 50 hours per week

Industry: Healthcare technology experience is preferred but not mandatory

About The Company

Zenara Health is a technology-oriented mental healthcare organization building clinical software for behavioral-health clinics. We work with sensitive healthcare data, so reliability, security, access control, backups, and compliance are not side concerns — they are part of the product ..

We are a startup, not a department. We move quickly, but we need to move with discipline because customers and patient data depend on us.

About The Role

We are looking for an AI-Native Platform Engineer to own DevOps, production reliability, security operations, and compliance foundations.

This is not a narrow DevOps ticket role.

This is not a compliance paperwork role.

This is a hands-on platform ownership role.

Today, platform, security, and compliance work is spread across people who are already covering other responsibilities. We need one full-time owner who keeps systems running, backed up, updated, monitored, secure, and HIPAA-ready ..

You will work closely with the Head of Engineering and a part-time senior security and compliance consultant ..

Here is the test: can you prove that backups restore, deployments roll back, secrets are controlled, alerts work, access is locked down, and compliance evidence exists before a customer asks for it?

We are looking for a calm, methodical operator who automates the boring things, finds the scary things, and closes the important gaps.

Our Platform Vision

We are building an AI-native healthcare software company. That means our platform must support speed without creating unacceptable risk.

The platform should make the safe path the easy path: reliable deployments, observable systems, tested recovery, controlled access, documented evidence, automated checks, and continuous security awareness.

You will help build this operating system, including:

- Deployment and rollback workflows
- Monitoring and alerting
- Backups and restore verification
- Secrets and access management
- Cloud configuration reviews
- Security checks on new code and infrastructure
- HIPAA compliance evidence
- Vendor and AI-tool risk tracking
- Daily automated security and compliance checks
- Incident response basics
- Platform documentation and runbooks

The goal is to create a platform that lets a small engineering team move rapid without gambling with production or patient data.

What You'll Do

- Own production platform operations: deployments, monitoring, alerts, updates, and reliability.
- Own backups and regularly prove restores work .
- Manage access control, secrets, cloud configuration, and security checks.
- Organize HIPAA-related policies, controls, audit evidence, and customer security documentation .
- Identify, prioritize, and close platform and security gaps.
- Build a daily security and compliance agent that sweeps systems and reports findings .
- Work weekly with a senior security and compliance consultant.
- Create runbooks, checklists, and automation for repeatable operational work.

jobs.description:

We are looking for a Senior Automation Engineer – Jenkins Administration & CI/CD Integrations to join a dedicated Agivant engineering pod. This role is ideal for a hands-on Jenkins expert with strong experience in Jenkins administration, pipeline automation, GitLab integration, and CI/CD troubleshooting. You will play a key role in optimizing CI/CD workflows by integrating GitLab with Jenkins, automating repository configurations, and developing reliable webhook-based integrations. The primary objective is to reduce manual effort, improve pipeline reliability, and streamline configurations across 40+ repositories.

Key Responsibilities

- Jenkins Administration: Administer, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Jenkins environments, including jobs, pipelines, plugins, credentials, agents/nodes, and build execution.
- CI/CD Pipeline Management: Develop, optimize, and maintain Jenkins pipelines using Jenkinsfiles and Groovy scripting. Ensure reliable pipeline execution and efficient build and deployment workflows.
- GitLab–Jenkins Integration: Configure and maintain GitLab integrations with Jenkins, enabling automated pipeline triggers through webhooks and repository events.
- Webhook Integration & Routing: Configure and troubleshoot webhook delivery from GitLab to multiple downstream Jenkins pipelines. Develop or maintain intermediary services such as RelayProxy, or configure suitable tunneling and routing tools where required.

- API-Based Automation: Use GitLab REST APIs and scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or Go to automate configurations, validate migrations, and reduce repetitive manual work.
- Bulk Repository Configuration: Execute and validate automated configuration changes across 40+ repositories, improving operational efficiency and reducing manual intervention.
- Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Diagnose Jenkins build failures, webhook delivery issues, plugin conflicts, agent connectivity problems, authentication errors, and CI/CD integration bottlenecks.
- Documentation & Operational Support: Maintain technical documentation, automation scripts, and troubleshooting procedures while ensuring reliable day-to-day CI/CD operations.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

- 6–9 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, CI/CD engineering, build and release automation, or Jenkins administration.
- Strong hands-on expertise in Jenkins administration, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting in production environments.
- Experience creating and maintaining Jenkins pipelines using Jenkinsfiles and Groovy.
- Strong understanding of Jenkins architecture, controller-agent configuration, plugins, credentials management, build execution, and pipeline security.
- Practical experience integrating Jenkins with GitLab using webhooks, repository events, APIs, and authentication mechanisms.
- Experience troubleshooting pipeline triggers, failed builds, webhook delivery, and connectivity issues.
- Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language, preferably Python, Bash, or Go.
- Working knowledge of GitLab REST APIs and Git-based repository management.
- Exposure to Terraform and Infrastructure as Code for configuration automation.
- Understanding of HTTP/HTTPS, network routing, reverse proxies, webhook payloads, and request/response hand

jobs.title: Application Security (AppSec) / DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Application Security (AppSec) / DevSecOps Engineer

Job Details
• Employment Type: Contract

• Work Mode: Remote

• Location: Offshore

• Total Experience Required: 4 to 8 years

• Relevant Experience Required: 3+ years of dedicated experience securing software development lifecycles (SDLC) and engineering DevSecOps pipelines

• Mandatory Certification: Certified Application Security Engineer (CASE), Certified DevSecOps Professional (CDP), CSSLP, or CEH

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Application Security / DevSecOps Engineer to bake robust safety controls directly into our automated software delivery frameworks. The ideal candidate will bridge software engineering with security operations, implementing automated code testing gates, leading threat modeling workshops, and hardening application containers to identify and mitigate software vulnerabilities before code hits production.

Key Responsibilities
• Design and integrate automated security testing gates directly into modern CI/CD pipelines (e.g., , , ).

• Configure and manage application scanning frameworks, orchestrating Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), and Software Composition Analysis (SCA) tooling.

• Triage and remediate software vulnerabilities, analyzing code flaws, open-source dependency risks, and secret exposure incidents alongside software development teams.

• Lead comprehensive threat modeling assessments for new applications and architecture features, identifying attack surfaces and defining secure coding frameworks.

• Govern application security infrastructure, managing centralized vulnerability aggregation dashboards (e.g., , ) and secret vaults (e.g., , ).

• Secure containerized application workloads, auditing Dockerfile construction rules, verifying baseline machine images, and checking Kubernetes network isolation parameters.

• Drive application layer incident investigations, analyzing malicious payload web requests, API tampering logs, and cross-site scripting (XSS) vectors to improve software perimeters.

Requirements
• 4 to 8 years of core software engineering or cloud DevOps experience, with 3+ dedicated years actively designing, building, and deploying application safety frameworks.

• Strong technical mastery of automated testing engines (e.g., , , Veracode, ), container security paradigms, and infrastructure-as-code hardening.

• Deep structural understanding of the OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, API security perimeters, modern secure coding standards, and cryptographic signing protocols.

• Mandatory certification: CASE, CDP, CSSLP, or CEH.

Preferred Qualifications
• Prior experience with software development in languages like Java, Python, JavaScript/Node.js, or Go.

• Experience implementing automated code patching routines or managing runtime application self-protection (RASP) layers.

jobs.title: Finance Data and AI Lead
jobs.description:
GAQ327R175  
  About the Role  
  This role is a part of the Finance Organisation.  
 As Finance Data Lead on the Finance Data and AI team, you will be the technical authority behind the data pipelines, AI systems, and internal applications that power Databricks' Finance and Accounting organisation. You will report to the Senior Manager, Finance Data and AI and serve as the individual contributor who sets the technical bar, drives architectural decisions, and delivers the highest-complexity work on the team. This individual is expected to be based in Bengaluru. 
 This is a high-impact role at the intersection of finance domain expertise and data platform capability. You will work closely with a team of finance data engineers as a technical lead and mentor, and partner directly with Accounting, FP&A, and Finance leadership to define what gets built and how. 
  What You Will Do:  
 
 Design and develop ETL pipelines using Databricks SQL and Python / PySpark to enhance reporting, automate journal entries, and transform core financial processes across various domains in accounting and FP&A, such as revenue, expenses, equity, commissions, and tax 
 Architect, build, and own the most complex finance data pipelines in the Finance data lake using Databricks Jobs and Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines with built-in data validation and reconciliations 
 Lead the technical design of AI use cases for the Finance and Accounting organisation, including forecasting automation, anomaly detection, and natural language interfaces to financial data 
 Build and maintain internal Finance applications (Databricks Apps, Genie Agents, AI/BI dashboards) that enable self-service for non-technical Finance stakeholders 
 Design and deliver curated Finance datasets and enforce row-level security, data access policies, and Unity Catalog governance standards 
 Define and champion coding standards, data modelling conventions, documentation practices, and testing frameworks across the Finance engineering team 
 Enforce and evolve Git-based version control, pull-request review processes, and CI/CD pipelines (Declarative Automation Bundles, GitHub Actions) to satisfy SOX change management requirements 
 Lead technical scoping and solutioning for requirements from Accounting, FP&A, Internal Audit, and Procurement teams 
 Serve as the primary technical point of contact during financial close, ensuring data accuracy and timely resolution of pipeline issues 
 Partner with IT and Engineering on new system integrations, providing detailed technical requirements and leading UAT 
 Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, pairing, and design discussions, raising the technical quality of the broader team 
 Proactively identify architectural debt, performance bottlenecks, and tooling gaps, and drive resolution with minimal direction 
 
  What We Look For:  
 
 12+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or finance systems, with a track record of owning complex, production-grade pipelines end-to-end 
 Deep proficiency in SQL and Python; hands-on experience with Apache Spark and the Databricks platform 
 Experience building and maintaining ELT/ETL pipelines from financial source systems (NetSuite, Salesforce, Stripe, Zuora, or similar) into a centralised data lake 
 Strong understanding of core finance and accounting concepts, including close processes, revenue recognition, intercompany, chart of accounts, and financial reporting

 The CPQ & NPI Operations team sits within Product Operations and is at the core of how we bring new products to market and optimise our quote-to-cash process. We don’t just operationalise new SKUs—we ensure seamless integration of next-generation quoting tools, drive automation, and enhance the overall sales experience. We partner across Product, Engineering, Sales, Deal Desk, and Finance to streamline how products are configured, quoted, sold, and provisioned. Our team ensures that our CPQ and Product Master tools remain high-performing, scalable systems—balancing automation, policy enforcement, and ease of use without overloading it with unnecessary complexity. 
 
 About the role: 
 
 We are seeking a highly driven, enterprising individual with exceptional communication skills to join our NPI Operations team and help operationalise our products in our quote-to-cash processes. In this full-time hybrid role, you’ll use your NPI and CPQ knowledge to translate strategy into operational reality: aligning with cross-functional partners on process and policy, compiling requirements, and delivering efficient, scalable solutions from New Product Introduction (NPI) through End of Life (EOL). 
 
 What you'll do: 
 
 Support GTM initiatives and new product launches; be accountable for CPQ and NPI deliverables that drive product growth and improve sales productivity. 
 Own the NPI Operations ticket queue and dashboards: triage, assign, track, and follow up to meet SLAs and prevent escalations; balance day-to-day support with small to medium projects. 
 Regularly compile reports and provide clear status updates; communicate timelines, risks, and decisions to stakeholders. 
 Deliver NPI releases and bug fixes based on priority; execute predefined processes independently and escalate for support or visibility when appropriate. 
 Lead CPQ and NPI enhancements and initiatives end-to-end: requirements analysis, consensus-building, solution design, testing, documentation, training, and launch. 
 Partner closely with IT and cross-functional teams to design scalable, agile solutions and drive timely delivery through effective coordination and communication. 
 Maintain the product master and ensure SKU configuration integrity across PDM and CPQ environments; recommend improvements grounded in best practices. 
 Analyse and optimise CPQ and NPI processes to drive efficiency and scalability; assess upstream/downstream impacts across PDM, CPQ, billing, and renewals. 
 Work across the full quote-to-cash lifecycle—from packaging, pricing, and selling to growth, retention, and EOL transitions—to drive cross-functional alignment. 
 Create, maintain, and deliver training and documentation for all new implementations to drive adoption and ensure stakeholders are enabled as products and processes roll out. 
 Mentor junior analysts on CPQ/NPI processes and best practices.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - CPD (IAM)
jobs.description:
Location : Bangalore/Pune About Team & About Role:   
  As a Senior Software Engineer (SSE) in the Continuous Product Delivery (CPD) team, you will play a key role in providing long term stability and last mile delight to our customers. You will work closely with the core engineering team, product, and support org. 
 You will be working across Rubrik releases on our on-premise data backup & management offering, with a focus on the identity and access layer that secures it. You are expected to develop a strong understanding of our product and engineering architecture — particularly how authentication and authorization flow through the system, including our integrations with enterprise identity providers, directory services, and certificate-based trust chains. 
 We are seeking a highly skilled Golang developer with deep, practical experience in identity protocols (OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0) and applied cryptography/PKI. As a Software Engineer on this team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and hardening the systems that authenticate users, machines, and services across our platform — reasoning carefully about threat models, not just shipping features. You should have strong programming and troubleshooting skills, excellent design skills, and a solid understanding of distributed systems, OS fundamentals, and networking. The successful candidate will preferably have working knowledge of Active Directory and be able to work independently and as part of a team.   
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  Responsibilities    
 
 Design, build, and harden identity and access flows — OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, Active Directory integrations — that sit in front of mission-critical systems. 
 Own token and assertion lifecycle correctness: issuance, validation, expiry, rotation, and failure-mode handling for JWT/JWKS and SAML assertions. 
 Apply strong applied-cryptography and PKI practices (X.509 certs, key rotation, TLS) to keep the auth path secure by default, not as an afterthought. 
 Build and maintain reverse-proxy/HTTP-layer components (TLS termination, header handling) that front customer authentication traffic. 
 Debug and resolve customer-facing identity/access issues, working with support to triage escalations quickly. 
 Contribute to build/release and cross-platform packaging (Linux deb/rpm, Windows MSI) as needed. 
 Maintain a small Windows companion application written in C#/.NET. 
 Write and enhance end-to-end tests covering auth flows, failure modes, and edge cases (clock skew, revoked tokens, malformed assertions, etc.). 
 Document known issues, workarounds, and design decisions in the team knowledge base as the team and product mature. 
 Communicate clearly with product and engineering stakeholders on design tradeoffs, security posture, and escalation status. 
 
   Requirements    Must-have  
 
 Minimum experience of at least 8 Years 
 Strong hands-on programming skills in  Golang . 
 Deep, practical knowledge of identity protocols:  OIDC/OAuth 2.0  and  SAML 2.0  — including token/assertion internals, standard flows, and failure modes. 
 Working knowledge of  Active Directory . 
 Applied cryptography/PKI experience:  X.509, JWT/JWKS, key rotation, TLS . 
 Strong security engineering discipline — comfortable reasoning about threat models and building software to protect mission-critical systems, not just make features work. 
 Solid understanding of OS fundamentals, networking, and concurrency.

jobs.description:
About the team   
  The Information Security organization advances the overall state of security at Rubrik through purposeful initiatives and coordination of large security projects. Information Security builds technologies, tools, and processes to better enable teams at Rubrik to develop secure software and protect data and systems with appropriate security controls. Information Security also develops systems to monitor and respond to attacks against our systems, provides awareness education to teams on security best practices for data protection, and ensures data sharing relationships with third parties in order to securely protect Rubrik information.  
  About the role  
  The Staff Cloud Security Architect will serve as a critical subject matter expert, responsible for defining, designing, and implementing secure cloud architectures and solutions across our enterprise environments. As a key technical leader, you will collaborate with engineering and cross-functional teams across Rubrik to integrate security across all aspects of cloud deployment, operations, and management. Your strategic insights will help shape cloud security strategies, reference architectures, governance frameworks, and compliance requirements. Your deep technical expertise, ability to influence, build and establish best practices, and thought leadership will ensure the secure enablement of our cloud technologies across our hybrid and public cloud environments. This is a hands-on technical role, and you will be expected to rely on your extensive cloud expertise to make an immediate impact on existing and new initiatives.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Product Infra: Core Services
jobs.description:
About the team   
  The Polaris Platform Bangalore team (a.k.a. Legion team) at Rubrik provides the core platforms and systems that enable product engineers to efficiently build and operate scalable and reliable applications in the cloud and also the on-prem version of the control plane. Polaris Platform has a horizontal charter with our customers being both external customers as well as Rubrik internal teams. Presently, the Legion team is working on enabling product led trials, license management & enforcement, making  its cloud deployment infrastructure more efficient. Legion team also owns the on-prem RSC (RSC-P) version and is currently working on supporting it on different deployments, while ensuring it scales and is performant like its cloud counterpart.   
   About the role   
  We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our team. We believe in giving engineers responsibility, not tasks. Our goal is to motivate and challenge people to do their best work. To do that, we have a very fluid structure and give people flexibility to work on projects that they enjoy the most. This develops more capable engineers, and keeps everyone engaged and happy. To address challenges of huge year over year growth, our team is constantly re-imagining our platform. This is an exciting time to join as we are constantly improving and innovating on each of our core layers.  
  Some recent projects include:  
 
  Enabling product assisted trials to decrease sales cycles  
  Bringing in Licensing visibility and enforcement for customers  
  Scaling our single node on-prem control plane (RSC-P) to multi node  
  Bringing in deployment efficiency to improve developer productivity  
 
   What you’ll do   
 
  Build our platforms, systems and infrastructure using your strong background in distributed systems and large scale storage systems.  
  Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain and improve the software.  
  Manage individual projects priorities, deadlines and deliverables with your technical expertise.  
 
   Experience and qualifications you’ll need   
 
  Rubrik Software Engineers are self-starters, driven, and can manage themselves. Bottom line,if you have a limitless drive and like to win, we want to talk to you - come make history!  
  Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or equivalent in computer science or related field  
    6 months - 1 year of total work experience

Interloop is a People Process and Technology consulting firm with offices in India and the UAE. jobs.description:
Job Description

EDI and IDOC test strategy and execution

• Design and execute test scripts for inbound and outbound EDI transactions and their IDOC counterparts (for example ORDERS, ORDRSP, DESADV, INVOIC, SHPMNT, WHSCON)

• Validate segment and field level mapping between partner formats (ANSI X12, EDIFACT) and SAP IDOC structures

• Confirm control record, status record, and partner profile accuracy across message types

• Build and maintain regression suites for high volume, recurring partner flows

Interface and mapping validation

• Verify Seeburger mapping logic, translation rules, and acknowledgment handling (997, CONTRL) against functional specifications

• Confirm end to end data integrity from partner transmission through middleware to the S/4HANA document

• Validate error handling, reprocessing, and reconciliation paths for failed transmissions

• Test partner onboarding and repointing scenarios, including qualifier, ISA/GS envelope, and connectivity changes

Defect management and governance

• Log, triage, and track defects in SAP Cloud ALM with clear severity, reproduction steps, and evidence

• Perform root cause analysis with development, functional, and Seeburger integration teams

• Confirm retests and closure against documented expected results

• Maintain traceability from business process to test case to requirement to interface object

Test data and environment readiness

• Prepare representative master and transactional data for realistic EDI and IDOC scenarios

• Validate partner profiles, ports, RFC destinations, and output determination in the test client

• Confirm middleware connectivity and certificate validity before cycle start

• Support entrance and exit criteria validation for ST, IT, and UAT cycles aligned to SAP Activate

Monitoring and production support in a COE model

• Provide L2 and L3 QA support for EDI and IDOC incidents, defects, and service requests

• Use IDOC monitoring transactions (WE02, WE05, WE19, BD87) and Seeburger monitoring to isolate failures

• Support cutover, go live, and hypercare with interface validation and reconciliation

• Maintain test documentation, defect logs, and support runbooks for recurring interface issues

Quality and reporting

• Apply consistent test evidence standards so readiness is provable, not asserted

• Produce daily execution, defect aging, and interface readiness reporting for leadership visibility

• Contribute to regression and negative testing coverage across partner and document variations

Required qualifications

• Bachelor s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or equivalent experience

• 3+ years of QA or integration testing experience, including EDI and IDOC interfaces

• Hands on experience validating IDOC processing in SAP, including S/4HANA

• Working knowledge of ANSI X12 and EDIFACT standards and common transaction sets

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Payin
jobs.description:
Who we are  
  About Stripe  
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
  About the Organization   
 Payments is at the core of Stripe’s mission to increase the GDP of the internet. We are expanding our payments footprint in India and we are looking for Backend Engineers to own the technical architecture behind our next generation of payment offerings in India.  
 As part of the India Payments team, you will build on top of Stripe’s robust foundational platforms, driving complex integrations and contributing to the architectural evolution of the critical services that handle money movement every millisecond. You will engineer the entire horizontal payments stack, driving every phase of a transaction's journey: integrating with local payment rails, managing initiation and intelligent routing, ensuring reliable completion and automating reconciliation and payouts.  
 Partnering with cross-functional engineering hubs globally, you will tackle high-stakes technical challenges requiring low-latency execution, strict transactional idempotency, zero-downtime migrations and resilient distributed state management at scale. 
 If you thrive on taking ambiguous product mandates and turning them into fault-tolerant, self-healing distributed systems, you will feel right at home here. 
  What You’ll Do (Core Responsibilities)  
 
 Architect and operate low-latency, fault-tolerant backend microservices that integrate with Indian payment methods 
 Map complex, India-specific payment flows into Stripe’s global, unified API platforms, ensuring a seamless integration experience for developers worldwide 
 Design highly reliable adapter layers that interact with domestic banking partners and payment networks, building systems that gracefully handle external API latency and asynchronous callbacks 
 Own end-to-end service health, implementing shadow rollouts, distributed tracing, automated failovers and proactive alerting for 99.99% uptime

jobs.title: Business Analyst, Innovation lab

Description

Amazon's operations network (Fulfilment Centres, Sort Centres, IXDs, Return Centres, Last Mile Stations, Quick Commerce hubs and Micro Fulfilment Centres) is the physical engine at the heart of Amazon. It moves billions of units of inventory, employs tens of thousands of people, and makes sure customers get what they want when promised. The Innovation Lab at BLR8 pilots and proves new automation solutions, such as Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs), automated packing equipment and internally developed tools, before they scale across this network.

The selected candidate will build and maintain the data platform, tools and reporting that tell us whether each pilot is working. They will also dig into the data to find the root cause of defects and give the team the evidence it needs to decide which solutions scale. - Build the data foundation for every trial: write the SQL queries and extracts that pull pilot data from operational systems
- Design and maintain dashboards that show each trial's progress against its success criteria
- Set up alerts and exception reports that flag when a trial metric moves off target, so the team can act the same day

- Analyse dashboard and alert trends to find the root cause of defects and underperformance, and propose specific actions
- Support site-readiness analysis when a solution moves to a new site
- Run pilots on the floor to the agreed test plan
- Collect physical data (time studies, downtime and fault logs) and keep the issue log up to date
- Follow and enforce pilot-area safety controls, including pre-trial checks for automation zones

- 1+ years of capacity planning, operations planning, business analysis or similar experience

- Knowledge of SQL and Excel at a moderate or advanced level

jobs.title: Software Engineer - IAM
jobs.description:
Location : Pune About Team & About Role:   
   
 As a Software Engineer (SE) in the Continuous Product Delivery (CPD) team, you will play a key role in providing long term stability and last mile delight to our customers. You will work closely with the core engineering team, product, and support org. 
 You will be working across Rubrik releases on our on-premise data backup & management offering, with a focus on the identity and access layer that secures it. You are expected to develop a strong understanding of our product and engineering architecture — particularly how authentication and authorization flow through the system, including our integrations with enterprise identity providers, directory services, and certificate-based trust chains. 
 We are seeking a highly skilled Golang developer with deep, practical experience in identity protocols (OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0) and applied cryptography/PKI. As a Software Engineer on this team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and hardening the systems that authenticate users, machines, and services across our platform — reasoning carefully about threat models, not just shipping features. You should have strong programming and troubleshooting skills, excellent design skills, and a solid understanding of distributed systems, OS fundamentals, and networking. The successful candidate will preferably have working knowledge of Active Directory and be able to work independently and as part of a team. 
   
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
   
  Responsibilities    
 
 Design, build, and harden identity and access flows — OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, Active Directory integrations — that sit in front of mission-critical systems. 
 Own token and assertion lifecycle correctness: issuance, validation, expiry, rotation, and failure-mode handling for JWT/JWKS and SAML assertions. 
 Apply strong applied-cryptography and PKI practices (X.509 certs, key rotation, TLS) to keep the auth path secure by default, not as an afterthought. 
 Build and maintain reverse-proxy/HTTP-layer components (TLS termination, header handling) that front customer authentication traffic. 
 Debug and resolve customer-facing identity/access issues, working with support to triage escalations quickly. 
 Contribute to build/release and cross-platform packaging (Linux deb/rpm, Windows MSI) as needed. 
 Maintain a small Windows companion application written in C#/.NET. 
 Write and enhance end-to-end tests covering auth flows, failure modes, and edge cases (clock skew, revoked tokens, malformed assertions, etc.). 
 Document known issues, workarounds, and design decisions in the team knowledge base as the team and product mature. 
 Communicate clearly with product and engineering stakeholders on design tradeoffs, security posture, and escalation status. 
 
   Requirements    Must-have  
 
 Strong hands-on programming skills in  Golang . 
 Deep, practical knowledge of identity protocols:  OIDC/OAuth 2.0  and  SAML 2.0  — including token/assertion internals, standard flows, and failure modes. 
 Working knowledge of  Active Directory . 
 Applied cryptography/PKI experience:  X.509, JWT/JWKS, key rotation, TLS . 
 Strong security engineering discipline — comfortable reasoning about threat models and building software to protect mission-critical systems, not just make features work. 
 Solid understanding of OS fundamentals, networking, and concurrency. 
 Working knowledge of Linux; comfortable writing shell/bash scripts.

About the Team 
 
Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.
 
Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us. 😉
 
We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.
 
But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Model API Platform
jobs.description:
About Sarvam

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India's full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India's leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC and LIC.


About the role

Sarvam's model APIs (ASR, TTS, Vision, LLM, Translate) are how developers and enterprises ship products on our foundation models. The platform handles tens of millions of API calls every day, over HTTP and WebSockets, with metering, billing, prepaid wallets and rate-limiting all part of the same stack.

We are hiring a Software Engineer to own major parts of this platform end to end, working closely with the Staff Engineer who leads its architecture. You will take an area such as speech to text pipeline,or text to speech pipeline, and be accountable for its reliability, performance and end-to-end latencies. This role is for someone who is obsessed with latencies, optimizes services and network paths to shave off milliseconds, ships fast, reasons from first principles, and treats AI as the default way to get engineering work done.


What you will do


Own a platform area end to end

• Own one or more major parts of the platform, such as the WebSocket streaming layer, a speech recognition pipeline, or text to speech pipeline: build, operate and improve them.

• Turn loosely defined goals into RFCs, milestones and shipped results, and write down the decisions and trade-offs.

• Be accountable after launch: on-call, incident response, root-cause analysis and follow-through on fixes.

• Make the call when a decision is needed, and own the outcome.

• Obsessed with latencies, dissecting existing services to understand the system, and tuning the right knobs to optimize performance.

• Bring services across without regressions in customer-facing APIs, latency or reliability.


Build real-time and model-serving pipelines

• Build and operate streaming infrastructure: WebSocket connections, long-lived sessions queue-based batch processing, backpressure and low-latency model invocation.

• Engineer audio pipelines: TTS chunking around model context limits, sample-rate conversion and format encoding, and VAD-based silence detection for ASR.

• Hold your services to sub-100ms latency SLOs in a multi-tenant environment, and know where every millisecond goes.


Think in systems and from first principles

• Reasons from constraints: latency budgets per hop, throughput, cost per request, failure modes and tenant isolation.

• Use back-of-the-envelope estimates to decide what to build, what to optimize and what to leave alone.

• Prefer simple designs you can fully explain over clever ones you cannot.

• Build in observability from day one: logging, metrics and tracing that let anyone debug production quickly.


Raise the bar for the team

• Strengthen the integration testing harness so the team can ship fast without breaking customer-facing APIs.

• Partner with the Inference and MLOps teams on making model serving fast, reliable and operable.

• Mentor junior engineers through RFC reviews, code review and pairing.

• Practice design-first, documentation-first engineering: RFCs before code, no tribal knowledge.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Framework Integrations
jobs.description:
AI frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and n8n are quickly becoming the default way developers build with AI — and MongoDB wants to be the data platform that shows up everywhere they build. As part of the AI Builders Experience (ABX) org, we're standing up a brand new engineering team in Gurugram to make that happen, and we're looking for Senior Software Engineers to be among its founding members. 
 The team owns the connective layer between MongoDB and third-party AI frameworks, platforms, and tools — the integrations that let developers use MongoDB effectively with the AI stack they've already chosen. That means shipping into some of the fastest-moving open-source ecosystems in tech, working mostly in Python and TypeScript, and partnering with the Database Experience (DBX) org when an integration needs new driver, platform, or product capability underneath it. 
 This is a self-sufficient team by design. You and your engineering manager will be based in Gurugram, and the group is set up to own its area end to end: to decide how integrations get built, tested, released, and maintained, without waiting on another time zone to unblock the day-to-day. You'll work closest with the engineers sitting next to you, pairing on hard problems, reviewing each other's code, and dividing up a broad portfolio, while collaborating with product, partners, field teams, and open source maintainers as the work requires. 
 You'll integrate with fast-moving, often unproven technologies, make pragmatic calls in the face of ambiguity, and own high-visibility projects with minimal guidance. Priorities can shift week to week based on framework changes, customer demand, and partner needs, so we're looking for product-minded engineers who thrive on autonomy and take pride in shipping. Much of your work will happen in public: sending pull requests to upstream repositories, working through external maintainer review cycles, and representing MongoDB in developer communities. 
 MongoDB engineering teams pride themselves on building high-quality software and living our cultural values every day — we value intellectual curiosity, intellectual honesty, customer empathy, and building together in an environment that prioritizes collaboration over competition. 
 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. 
 Position expectations 
 
 Design, build, test, and ship MongoDB integrations across a broad AI framework ecosystem that includes technologies like LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, n8n, and Mastra, owning them from first exploratory spike through production release and ongoing maintenance. 
 Take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them to completion independently, making sound decisions as requirements, frameworks, and customer needs evolve. 
 Do the initial, exploratory work: assess a new framework, define the smallest useful version of an integration, get it in front of users quickly, and make a clear recommendation about whether and how to invest further. 
 Contribute high-quality code upstream to repositories MongoDB doesn't own, maintaining a high standard of professionalism and courtesy while working through external maintainer review cycles. 
 Build and maintain the team's engineering practices for a broad integration portfolio, including CI/CD, automated testing across framework and server versions, version compatibility awareness, and release readiness.
